name: Gulnar
subtitle: The Heirloom
description: A bridal long shirt in deep crimson, paired with a two-legged sharara and dupatta. Hand-worked throughout in resham, dabka, zardozi, cut dana, and sitare. Accompanied by a single tanka resham shawl, fully hand-embroidered — available separately. Designed today but destined to become an everlasting heirloom for you and your loved ones.
fabricNotes: Crafted in-house. Long shirt + two-legged sharara + dupatta. Hand-work techniques include resham, dabka, zardozi, cut dana, and sitare. Companion piece: single tanka resham shawl, fully hand-embroidered, available together or separately.
